finding: Claim renewal can report actor-vs-actor `ATM_TASK_CLAIM_OWNER_MISMATCH` when the actual mismatch is between lane session ids under `ownershipMode: lane-id`; additionally, an `ATM_LANE_SESSION_ID` fallback pointing at an expired lane is silently rejected and a fresh lane is minted until the user manually runs lane adopt.
expectedBehavior: Lane-owned claims need lane-vs-lane error codes and copy, plus a stable adopt/rebind path. If an environment-provided lane is expired but otherwise authorized, the CLI should either adopt/rebind it or emit a precise stale-lane recovery command instead of quietly minting an incompatible session.
evidenceOrRepro: TASK-AAO-0206 close recovery on 2026-07-29: `tasks renew` showed currentActor and actorId both as `claude-005-aao-0206`, while detailed data showed different holding/requested laneSessionId values. Later retry with `ATM_LANE_SESSION_ID` still failed until `lane adopt` re-bound the stale TTL lane.
followUp: Split OWNER_MISMATCH by ownership mode, add stale-lane adopt semantics to `resolveLaneSession`, and cover renew/close recovery with regression tests for expired-but-adoptable lane ids.
